high_level_description: The Bloodridge raiders' shrine on a floating snowy island: a giant burning ring raised between two dark pylons, ram skulls and antlers on poles, cracks in the ground glowing with lava, faceless hooded figures kneeling before it.

style_description.aesthetics: a lived in war camp seen from a little above, busy with small figures, warm against cold snow
style_description.lighting: warm sunlight from the upper right, short blue shadows falling to the lower left
style_description.art_style: crisp pixel art with clean dark outlines, flat shading in few colours, figures a few pixels tall

compositional_deconstruction.background: a floating island with a flat snowy top and blue ice cliffs, over a white sea of clouds, under a clear blue sky

elements.desc: a giant ring of fire standing upright between two dark Egyptian pylons
poles topped with ram skulls and antlers
cracks in the snowy ground glowing orange with lava
faceless hooded figures with ember eyes kneeling in rows before the ring
